state.seed_assertion: A DPIA must include description of the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing, assessment of necessity and proportionality, identification and assessment of risks, and identification of additional mitigation measures.

sentences.1: A DPIA must include description of the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing, assessment of necessity and proportionality, identification and assessment of risks, and identification of additional mitigation measures.
sentences.2: Your DPIA must: describe the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing;
sentences.3: assess necessity, proportionality and compliance measures;
sentences.4: identify and assess risks to individuals;
sentences.5: and identify any additional measures to mitigate those risks.
sentences.6: A DPIA process should include seven key steps: identifying the need, describing the processing, considering consultation, assessing necessity and proportionality, identifying and assessing risks, identifying mitigating measures, and signing off and recording outcomes.
sentences.7: It should include these steps: Step 1: identify the need for a DPIA Step 2: describe the processing Step 3: consider consultation Step 4: assess necessity and proportionality Step 5: identify and assess risks Step 6: identify measures to mitigate the risks Step 7: sign off and record outcomes
sentences.8: A DPIA must assess the necessity and proportionality of processing, including measures to ensure compliance and respect for GDPR principles.
sentences.9: Data protection compliance measures are a good measure of necessity and proportionality and should include lawful basis, prevention of function creep, data quality, data minimisation, privacy information provision, support for individual rights, processor compliance measures, and safeguards for international transfers.
sentences.10: A DPIA submission to the ICO must include descriptions of roles and responsibilities of joint controllers or processors, processing purposes and methods, protective measures and safeguards, DPO contact details, and a copy of the DPIA itself.
sentences.11: You must include: a description of the respective roles and responsibilities of any joint controllers or processors;
sentences.12: Risk assessment should consider potential impacts on individuals including inability to exercise rights, inability to access services, loss of control over personal data, discrimination, identity theft, fraud, financial loss, reputational damage, physical harm, loss of confidentiality, and re-identification of pseudonymised data.
